versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Java code quality and security gate skill.
- Provides zero-intrusive, tool-driven static analysis for Java/Spring Boot projects using PMD 7 + SpotBugs (with FindSecBugs).
- Enforces mandatory clearing of all Blocker and Critical issues before delivery.
- Adapts rule sets: reuses project’s own settings if present, otherwise applies built-in rules.
- Supports security and code quality scanning, automatically running in a wrapper directory without modifying the project’s existing configuration.
